rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something has been distorted or its intended meaning has been altered.

example.english: They twisted my meaning; I only wanted everyone to calm down.
example.traditional: 你唔好扭曲我嘅意思，我只係想大家冷靜啲。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 nau2 kuk1 ngo5 ge3 ji3 si1 ngo5 zi2 hai6 soeng2 daai6 gaa1 laang5 zing6 di1

rows.note: Use this for strands, threads, or similar things that have been physically twisted together.

example.english: The earphone cable and charging cable got twisted together and took me all morning to untangle.
example.traditional: 條耳機線同充電線扭埋一齊，拆咗我成個朝早。
example.jyutping: tiu4 ji5 gei1 sin3 tung4 cung1 din6 sin3 nau2 maai4 jat1 cai4 caak3 zo2 ngo5 seng4 go3 ziu1 zou2

rows.note: Use this when “twisted” means mentally abnormal or perverted, especially of a person, attitude, or sense of humour.

example.english: The jokes he tells are so twisted that we all feel uncomfortable.
example.traditional: 佢啲笑話咁變態，搞到我哋個個都唔舒服。
example.jyutping: keoi5 di1 siu3 waa2 gam3 bin3 taai3 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 go3 go3 dou1 m4 syu1 fuk6
